text:
Prem Rugby: England's Alex Mitchell injured as Northampton Saints, Bath, Saracens, Harlequins pick up victories
Saturday's Prem Rugby sees Northampton Saints beat Gloucester, Bath defeat Sale Sharks, Harlequins win at Exeter Chiefs and Saracens beat Newcastle Red Bulls; Northampton scrum-half Alex Mitchell an England worry as he suffers early injury at Franklin's Gardens
Saturday 31 October 2026 20:19, UK
Alex Mitchell provided an injury worry for England ahead of the Nations Championship as the scrum-half was forced off during Northampton's 28-14 win against Gloucester on Saturday evening.
Mitchell had to come off with just 21 minutes played due to a hamstring injury, walking down the Franklin's Gardens tunnel to be replaced by 20-year-old Jonny Weimann.
That will be a concern for England boss Steve Borthwick ahead of the game against Australia at Allianz Stadium, Twickenham next weekend, but Northampton did not let their loss stop them from defeating in-form Gloucester.
The Cherry and Whites, who had started the Prem weekend sitting top of the table, had come flying out of the blocks, taking a 14-0 lead.
But title holders Northampton showed their champion class as they bounced back to bag a bonus-point success on home soil.
Mitchell, 29, has already been sidelined with hamstring injuries on three separate occasions during 2026.
When asked about Mitchell, Northampton's Phil Dowson said: "Mitch has hurt his hamstring, but I don't know how bad.
"We have to be super careful with him and he knows his own body."
Bath 38-26 Sale Sharks
Bath returned to winning ways with a comfortable 38-26 bonus-point victory against Sale Sharks at the Rec.
After a number of disappointing outings, the hosts showed much-improved form with some inventive play creating a number of tries with their first triumph in three games.
Joe Cokanasiga scored two of them, Henry Arundell, Tom de Glanville and Louie Hennessey the others, with Finn Russell converting four and adding a penalty.
Nathan Jibulu, Tom O'Flaherty, Luke Cowan-Dickie and Elia Canakaivata scored Sale's tries, all of which George Ford converted.
Exeter Chiefs 28-31 Harlequins
Harlequins made it back-to-back Prem Rugby wins with a 31-28 triumph over Exeter at Sandy Park.
Quins demonstrated their much-improved recent form with a win they arguably deserved, while last season's beaten finalists Chiefs end the opening block of five league fixtures lying second from bottom of the table.
Lucas Schmid scored two of Harlequins' five tries while a late score from Olly Woodburn rescued two bonus points for Exeter, who had led 21-14 early in the second half.
Saracens 39-31 Newcastle Red Bulls
Noah Caluori proved he is in exhilarating form and ready to help lead England's attack in the coming Nations Championships matches by producing an stunning display in Saracens' 39-31 victory over Newcastle.
The electric youngster came on after the break to lift what had been a lacklustre and flat home performance by racing over for a score as Sarries ran in five second-half tries to finally get the better of visitors who had threatened an upset.
Caluori, 21, who made his England debut against Fiji in the Summer, is the most exciting wing prospect in the Prem and showed just why with his pace and strength.
But Sarries certainly needed his spark and energy having trailed 17-7 at the break with Red Bulls on top and looking dangerous despite giving up nine first-half penalties.
digest_he: נורת'המפטון סיינטס רשמה ניצחון ביתי מרשים של 28-14 על גלוסטר במסגרת הליגה, אך הבשורה המדאגת ביותר עבור נבחרת אנגליה הייתה פציעתו של הקשר אלכס מיטשל. מיטשל נפצע בשריר הירך האחורי כבר בדקה ה-21 והוחלף, מה שמעורר סימני שאלה לקראת משחקי גביע הלאומים הקרובים מול אוסטרליה. למרות הפיגור המוקדם 14-0 מול מוליכת הטבלה הזמנית, אלופת המדינה התאוששה והשיגה ניצחון עם נקודת בונוס. במשחקים נוספים שנערכו באותו מחזור, באת' גברה 38-26 על סייל שארקס הודות לצמד שערים של ג'ו קוקאנסיגה ויכולת טובה של פין ראסל. הרקווינס ניצחו בחוץ 31-28 את אקסטרט צ'יפס משערים של לוקאס שמיד, וסראסנס הפכו פיגור במחצית לניצחון 39-31 על ניוקאסל רד בולס, בזכות הופעה מצוינת של הצעיר נואה קלואורי במחצית השנייה שהבקיע אחד מחמשת השערים של קבוצתו.
